QuestInfo.name: Chief Tatamo's Spring Flower Research 1
QuestInfo.0: Spring blooms in Maple World. You hear that #bChief Tatamo in Leafre#k is researching spring flowers but he needs your help. Let's go talk to him!
QuestInfo.1: Let's help with the research to plant far more spring flowers!
QuestInfo.2: You successfully helped with the Spring Flower Research and finally, far more spring flowers bloom in Maple World.
QuestInfo.summary: Give 3 Azaleas to Chief Tatamo in Leafre.

0.0: Did you know that we are researching spring flowers for planting? We want far more of them in the Maple World! Your flowers will be a great help to our research.

yes.0: It will be a great help to the research on spring flowers in Maple World if you can deliver #b3 Azaleas#k to #bChief Tatamo in Leafre#k.  Hope you can do this now.

1.0: Finally, spring is coming to Maple World. Shiny days... I am researching spring flowers now so would you like to give me your Azaleas?

yes.0: Thank you so much! Hahaha. Please come and visit me anytime you want. You are a warm-hearted person.
yes.1: Azaleas mean 'love'. I hope this pink azalea will spread love around Maple World! I will give you an #bAzalea Sticker#k to always keep a loving mind.\r\n

npc.0: Why didn't you go to Chief Tatamo quickly? You have to go to Leafre and give him #b3 Azaleas#k.
